pages.text: Mature warrens breed worse than plague rats, and the dead draw their own followers.$(br2)$(l)Flea Clouds$() and $(l)Fly Swarms$() are only specks in the air: no blade touches them. Fire, or the smoke of a brazier or censer, is the only way. Fleas carry bubonic plague; flies spoil your meat.

pages.name: Sewer Rat
pages.text: Big, tough, and found below ground.

pages.name: Bloated Rat
pages.text: Swells when it reaches you, then bursts into miasma. Bursts when killed, too.

pages.name: Burrower Rat
pages.text: Lies in wait underground and leaps out when you pass. Only explosions reach it buried.

pages.name: Rat Swarm
pages.text: Bites everything it runs over. Fire does it double harm.

pages.name: Carrion Crow
pages.text: Circles the dead. Where there are crows, there are bodies.
